title: festuca laevis var. gallica
intro: Festuca laevis var. gallica, commonly known as Gallic fescue, is a type of grass in the family Poaceae. Gallic fescue has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gallic fescue include bronchodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as asthma. The bioactive constituents of Gallic fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
